# Vectorizerr

> High-performance raster-to-SVG vectorizer studio. Upload a PNG, JPG, WebP or other raster image and convert it into clean, editable SVG vector graphics in the browser — powered by a WebAssembly port of VTracer.

Vectorizerr is a client-side vectorization tool: images are processed locally in the browser via WebAssembly, and results can be previewed, downloaded as SVG, or exported as PNG/WebP. Paid generations are tracked server-side and stored in a per-user history.

## Pages

- [Home / Vectorizer](https://vectorizerr.pages.dev/): Main vectorization studio — upload an image, adjust trace parameters, preview the SVG, and export.
- [Support](https://vectorizerr.pages.dev/support): Contact form for billing, transaction, and technical issues.
- [Privacy Policy](https://vectorizerr.pages.dev/privacy): How user data, images, and transaction records are handled.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://vectorizerr.pages.dev/terms): Terms of service.
- [Conditions](https://vectorizerr.pages.dev/conditions): Usage conditions.
- [Contact](https://vectorizerr.pages.dev/contact): Contact information.

## How it works

1. Upload a raster image (PNG, JPG, WebP, etc.).
2. VTracer (WebAssembly) traces it into SVG paths — adjustable parameters include color mode, hierarchical detail level, splice/spoon settings, and more.
3. Preview the result as vector, side-by-side, split, raster, or raw SVG code.
4. Export: SVG download, SVG code copy, or free PNG/WebP raster export.

## Pricing & credits

- Vectorization preview is free.
- Downloading or copying validated SVG output consumes 1 generation from an image unlock.
- 1 credit unlocks an image for a fixed number of generations (configured server-side, currently 3).
- Credits are purchased via cryptocurrency (USDC and other tokens across EVM chains and Bitcoin) sent to per-user deposit addresses or fallback wallets; transactions are verified on-chain before crediting.
- Each validated generation is saved to the user's history (SVG + parameters); raw source images are stored only in the browser's local storage.
- Active subscribers have unlimited generations.

## Technical notes

- Frontend: Next.js (static export) on Cloudflare Pages.
- Backend: Cloudflare Worker API with Firestore persistence, on-chain transaction verification, and cryptographic handshake-based quota enforcement.
- Vectorization engine: VTracer compiled to WebAssembly, runs entirely client-side.
- Payments: EIP-1559 EVM transfers and Bitcoin, verified against per-chain contract/token/recipient configuration.

## Optional

- [Sign in](https://vectorizerr.pages.dev/signin): Google authentication required for purchases, history, and quota.
